intent: The deploy confirmation's consequence stops wearing the anonymous border DT-0004 retired, and its buttons stop being unreachable on a narrow screen.
rationale: Nothing new is decided here. DT-0004 ruled that a confirmation's consequence — the platform's own sentence about what the act does — wears the consequence role, and that the weight belongs there rather than on the button; the archive page has worn it since. Deploy was built alongside and kept `border border-border-default`, which is the treatment DT-0004 retired: an anonymous box that reads as one more paragraph rather than as the thing being agreed to. Deploy's consequence is the heaviest on this page — it names who is *replaced* when the coin is occupied — so it is the last one that should read as a caption. The action row gets the same mobile stack the archive page's got: `flex flex-wrap gap-3` puts two 44px controls side by side on a 320px viewport, where they either overflow or shrink below the tap-target floor the system states as a principle.

design.layout: Unchanged in order — heading, carried problem, consequence, form. The action row stacks under the tablet breakpoint and sits inline above it.

default.content: consequence: the block takes the consequence role — color.consequence.subtle background, 1px color.consequence.border border, radius.2, space.4 padding, color.text.primary. role=alert stays and the platform's sentence stays verbatim, including the replacement it names. perform-deploy: the form becomes a column at space.3 gap, turning to a wrapped row at breakpoint.tablet; the submit and the cancel each take full width below that breakpoint and auto width above it — the archive page's treatment, unchanged.

responsive.mobile: Buttons stacked, each full width, each at the size.control.min floor.

acceptance: The consequence block renders on color.consequence.subtle with a 1px color.consequence.border border at radius.2, and keeps role=alert
The platform's consequence sentence renders verbatim, including the name of any agent it says would be replaced
At a 320px viewport the submit and cancel are stacked, each full width, each at least size.control.min tall
At tablet width and above the two controls sit inline as they do today
The submit remains accent-styled, never danger — DT-0002's ruling
Zero copy changes anywhere on the page
No raw color, spacing, or size literal is introduced

references.value: Backlog 166. Applies DT-0004's consequence role and the archive page's mobile stack; decides nothing new.
